Edea is an obtainable Unit in the game. She serves as the main protagonist of the Grand Quest [[GQ:Palmyna|Four Heroes of Palmyna]] and is also the central character of the Grand Gaia Chronicles content of the [[GrandGaia:Edea|same name]].

==In-Game Appearance==
As an NPC character, Edea's first appearance is in [[GQ:Palmyna|Grand Quest - Four Heroes of Palmyna]].

==Background==
She is the Princess of the Kingdom of Palmyna who is clad in the legendary armor [[Lafdranya]] who fought alongside Loch, Lorand and Dean to defend the land of Palmyna against Cardes the Malevolent's wrath.
